rule: A visual edge is rendered only after its relationship type and source have been recorded.

relationshipTypes.direct_derivation: A language was explicitly derived from another language.
relationshipTypes.syntax_influence: Surface syntax or grammar was adopted or deliberately adapted.
relationshipTypes.object_model_influence: Classes, objects, delegation, or messaging influenced the design.
relationshipTypes.type_system_influence: Type-system or memory-safety ideas influenced the design.
relationshipTypes.runtime_ecosystem: A language interoperates with or targets another language's runtime/ecosystem.

sources.title: HOPL — Online Historical Encyclopaedia of Programming Languages
sources.use: Language identifiers, dates, and candidate influence links; every displayed relationship is then individually reviewed.

sources.title: The Java Language Specification
sources.use: Primary reference for Java's language semantics.
